title: Invertibility of the finite counit comparison
statement: In the coefficient setting of [def-pur-conventions], with l different from D.p, for the finite coefficient extension and finite-field datum of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], the intrinsic finite counit comparison finiteU is an isomorphism at every normalized quotient level.

proof.text: On the canonical affine open cover, take the composite open/structural adjunction and transport its left adjoint through openComposition. The cofinal finite-free/native quotient counit calculation [lem-sf-integral-finite-extension-affine-counit] makes the local ordinary etale mate invertible. Expanding homEquiv_ofNatIsoLeft and the transported counit identifies it with localMate.

Use the proved generic restrictedMate_adjunct and middleAdjunct_eq in [lem-coef-dualizing-open-mate] (these helpers allow arbitrary finite coefficient ring maps). Injectivity of the exceptional Hom equivalence identifies restrictedMate with localMate. Cancel the scalar/open isomorphism. The adopted source theorem Etale.isIso_of_isIso_mapDerivedCategoryUpperStar_map_of_jointlySurjective applied to X.affineCover now gives IsIso finiteEtaleU.

For the generic scalar restriction square, the etale/pro-etale mate is invertible by pbcComparisonReductionMap_isIso of [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. The intrinsic square is between the sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence equivalences of [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction], so iterated mates and conjugateEquiv_of_iso prove its mate invertible. Mathlib mateEquiv_vcomp composes these two isomorphisms. Expanding finiteRealizationRestriction identifies the resulting square with the actual realization restriction of the cross-field map.

The explicit transpose_transport calculation expresses the transported scalar adjunct as the invertible scalar mate component followed by the realized etale isomorphism. Naturality of the scalar adjunction puts the two origin isomorphisms on the endpoints. This is precisely the defining finiteU formula, hence finiteU is invertible.

old_proof.text: Use the finite-free coefficient-extension basis calculation to identify the scalar-extended finite dualizing counit with the finite counit comparison. The exceptional adjunction mate, the compact-support coefficient comparison, and the normalized realization maps are isomorphisms; closure of isomorphisms under composition and transport through the adjunction gives IsIso finiteU at every quotient level, including ramified and identity levels.
